_comment: Hand-made tags for spells whose records do not say what they are: blood,
water or wind magic that deals plain health damage through a script, and
elemental spells whose effect carries no element keyword or resistance.
Each rule names its spells by persistentId ("Plugin.esp|0x000D62" - the
id inside the plugin, so load order does not matter); a spell that is not
installed is simply never matched. "add" puts tags on; "remove" takes
wrong ones off, after every rule has added its own (the corrections at the
end: a rune's shared blast effect read as fire on a water rune, and so on).
Picked from a scan of a 1,440-spell load order (2026-09-21). To add your
own, copy a rule, or put yours in 90_user.json so an update of this file

rules._: Blood magic the rules below cannot see: Occult Cradle's The Power Within, Mysticism's Blood Lance
Mysticism's Vampiric spells ("Entropy" in the Korean translation): Vampiric Touch, Bolt, Grasp, Blast, Rune - health absorbed from the living
Water: Natura's Water Spray, the one water spell of the set without the water keyword
Earth: Natura's Stone Spray, the one stone spell of the set without the earth keyword
Wind: a frozen gale, and cold wind wrapped round the caster
Chaos Crucible: fire, frost and shock at once, through a script
Lost Grimoire's scripted frost spells: Arctic Fortress, Icy Veil
Lost Grimoire's scripted shock spells: Storm Rift, Electric Field
Lost Grimoire's Salamander Scales: fire ward that feeds on fire spells
Necromancer's Magic's Death's Touch: soul energy released as damage
Necromancer's Magic's unholy curses: Boneyard, and the lingering magicka and stamina curses
Read from the spell descriptions (2026-09-27): Glenmoril's Saint Vazra's Torch deals fire damage
Resist buffs carry their element (a fire shield is fire magic), as the weakness curses already do: raising a resist, not hostile
Holy light: Lightpower's Holy Flame, Sanctuary, Holy Purification, Judgement; Lost Grimoire's divine blessing, guardian and shield (not castable after a murder)
Lightpower's Judgement calls down sunlight
Blood magic, by rule (decided 2026-09-27): everything from a mod named for blood or vampires ...

... and the absorbs and drains vampires cast (castByVampires: a vampire NPC carries it, in its records or through an SPID ini). A mage's absorb health is not blood magic; a vampire's ice spike is not either
Absorbing magicka is arcane
Except the Creation Club Oblivion absorbs (Choking Grasp, Strangulation, Hangman's Noose, Touch of Death): choking, not blood - left without an element
Skyrim's Fire Storm is fire only
Natura's runes share a blast effect that reads as fire: stone, water and wind runes are not fire
Natura's Wind Rune is not water either
Natura's wind touch spells (Wind Touch, Wind Push, Wind Grasp) are not earth
Natura's Squall is wind, not shock
Arclight's Wall of Arclight is shock, not fire
Mysticism's Stormblast is lightning only
Summoned or conjured, not soul magic: Lost Grimoire's Flameheart, Fire-Brand, Ice-Breaker, Kitty's Supercharged Wisps
Mysticism's Frost Weakness is a frost bolt; the north-wind perk keyword is not wind
